summary: Aurora Cannabis filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 9, 2026 news release announcing the appointment of Faris El Refaie as Executive Vice President, Global Commercial, effective September 28, 2026. The newly created role oversees global commercial strategy across Canada, Europe, Australia, New Zealand and other international medical cannabis markets. El Refaie brings 25 years of biopharmaceutical experience, including JAMP Pharma Group, GSK and AstraZeneca. No financial terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics were disclosed. This is a routine executive appointment rather than an abrupt or forced CEO/CFO departure, so it is classified as None.
